content:
Overview

Swachh Bharat Mission 2.0 is the second phase of India's flagship cleanliness mission, launched in 2021 with a focus on sustaining the achievements of the first phase and addressing the broader challenges of waste management. The mission focuses on complete faecal sludge management, solid waste processing, and clean villages and cities. It also emphasises behavioural change towards cleanliness and hygiene through community participation.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all citizens, households, and communities across India
  • Households, urban local bodies, and gram panchayats participate in cleanliness activities
  • No income or category restrictions apply

Benefits

  • Improved solid waste management infrastructure and processing facilities
  • Cleaner villages and cities with better sanitation outcomes
  • Support for waste to wealth initiatives and recycling
  • Public awareness and behavioural change towards hygiene

How to Apply

  1. Citizens participate through cleanliness drives and swachhata app
  2. Households can report cleanliness issues through the Swachhata portal
  3. Local bodies implement the mission's projects as per the city or village plan

Required Documents

  • No documents are required for general participation
meta_title: Swachh Bharat Mission 2.0: Clean India & Waste Management
meta_description: Swachh Bharat Mission 2.0 focuses on solid waste management, faecal sludge processing, and sustaining cleanliness across India. Learn more.

content:
Overview

Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) is a flagship scheme that provides free LPG connections to women from below poverty line households. Launched in 2016, the scheme was expanded as Ujjwala 2.0 to cover more beneficiaries, including migrant families. The scheme protects women's health by reducing indoor air pollution from traditional cooking fuels and provides a clean cooking fuel option for households.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Women aged 18 years and above from below poverty line families
  • Households without an existing LPG connection
  • Identification through the Socio Economic Caste Census database
  • Ujjwala 2.0 also covers migrant families with necessary documents

Benefits

  • Free LPG connection in the name of the woman of the household
  • First refill and accessories provided free of cost in many cases
  • Reduced indoor air pollution and health risks from smoke
  • Time saving for women who no longer collect traditional fuels

How to Apply

  1. Visit the nearest LPG distributor with the required documents
  2. Complete the application form under the Ujjawala scheme
  3. The distributor verifies eligibility and delivers the connection kit

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card of the applicant and family members
  • BPL certificate or SECC identification
  • Bank account details
  • Address proof
meta_title: PM Ujjwala Yojana: Free LPG Connection for Women
meta_description: PMUY provides free LPG connections to women from BPL households, reducing smoke related health risks. Check eligibility and how to apply.

content:
Overview

The National Clean Air Programme (NCAP) is a national initiative of the Government of India to reduce air pollution across the country. Launched in 2019, the programme targets a reduction in particulate matter pollution in 131 non-attainment cities through city specific action plans. It includes measures for industrial emissions, vehicular pollution, dust control, and public awareness.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The programme covers 131 non-attainment cities identified for air quality improvement
  • City action plans are implemented by state and city agencies
  • No individual application is required; benefits accrue through cleaner air

Benefits

  • Improved air quality in cities through targeted action plans
  • Reduced health risks from particulate matter pollution
  • Monitoring and public information on air quality
  • Community awareness and citizen participation in clean air efforts

How to Apply

  1. No individual application is required under the programme
  2. Citizens can participate by following clean air practices and reporting issues

Required Documents

  • Not applicable for general beneficiaries
meta_title: National Clean Air Programme: Reducing Air Pollution
meta_description: NCAP aims to cut particulate pollution in 131 Indian cities through city action plans. Learn about the programme and its impact.

content:
Overview

The National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG) is the implementing body of the Namami Gange programme for the rejuvenation of the river Ganga. The mission coordinates pollution abatement projects, sewage treatment infrastructure, and river front development across the Ganga basin. It works with state governments and international partners to ensure continuous, adequate, and clean flow of the river.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The mission benefits communities and ecosystems in the Ganga basin
  • Projects are implemented through state nodal agencies and urban local bodies
  • No individual application is required for most interventions

Benefits

  • Reduced pollution through sewage treatment and industrial effluent control
  • River front development and improved public amenities at ghats
  • Conservation of the river's biodiversity and aquatic life
  • Public participation in river cleanliness and awareness programmes

How to Apply

  1. No individual application is required under the mission
  2. Volunteers and organisations can participate in cleanliness and awareness activities

Required Documents

  • Not applicable for general beneficiaries
meta_title: National Mission for Clean Ganga: River Rejuvenation
meta_description: NMCG implements Namami Gange projects for pollution abatement and river front development in the Ganga basin. Learn about the mission.

content:
Overview

The Electric Mobility Promotion Scheme is a government initiative to accelerate the adoption of electric vehicles in India. The scheme provides demand incentives on the purchase of electric two wheelers and three wheelers registered for commercial purposes. It supports the growth of the electric vehicle ecosystem and contributes to reducing vehicular emissions.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Buyers of eligible electric two wheelers and three wheelers can claim incentives
  • Vehicles must meet the technical specifications under the scheme
  • Incentives are passed through the vehicle manufacturers

Benefits

  • Demand incentive reducing the purchase cost of electric vehicles
  • Lower running costs compared to petrol or diesel vehicles
  • Reduced vehicular emissions and air pollution
  • Support for the growth of the domestic EV manufacturing ecosystem

How to Apply

  1. Purchase an eligible electric vehicle from a registered manufacturer or dealer
  2. The incentive is adjusted in the ex-showroom price by the manufacturer
  3. No separate application is needed by the buyer

Required Documents

  • Identity and address proof for vehicle purchase
  • Vehicle registration documents
meta_title: Electric Mobility Promotion Scheme: EV Purchase Incentives
meta_description: The Electric Mobility Promotion Scheme offers demand incentives on electric two and three wheelers. Learn about eligibility and benefits.

content:
Overview

The National Green Hydrogen Mission is a flagship programme of the Government of India to make the country a global hub for the production and use of green hydrogen. The mission supports the production of hydrogen from renewable energy sources, with a target capacity of 5 million tonnes per year. It funds pilot projects in green hydrogen production, electrolyser manufacturing, and hydrogen powered mobility.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Green hydrogen producers, electrolyser manufacturers, and project developers can participate
  • Projects are selected through the mission's competitive bidding and approval processes
  • Consumers and industries benefit from the availability of green hydrogen

Benefits

  • Reduction in carbon emissions through clean hydrogen use
  • Creation of a domestic green hydrogen manufacturing ecosystem
  • Employment and investment opportunities in clean energy
  • Support for hard to decarbonise sectors such as steel, fertilisers, and refining

How to Apply

  1. Project developers apply through the mission's portal and bidding rounds
  2. Submit the project proposal with technical and financial details
  3. Approved projects receive the mission's support as per the guidelines

Required Documents

  • Project proposal and technical details
  • Company registration and financial documents
meta_title: National Green Hydrogen Mission: India's Clean Fuel Push
meta_description: The National Green Hydrogen Mission aims to make India a global green hydrogen hub with 5 million tonne capacity. Learn about the mission.

content:
Overview

The National Wetland Conservation Programme aims to conserve and manage wetlands in India, which are vital ecosystems supporting biodiversity and water security. The programme focuses on the wise use of wetlands, prevention of encroachment, and restoration of degraded wetland areas. Identified wetlands receive conservation support through state governments and management committees.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Wetlands identified under the programme receive conservation support
  • State governments and local communities participate in management
  • No individual application is required

Benefits

  • Conservation of biodiversity and water bodies
  • Improved water security and flood regulation in wetland areas
  • Livelihood support through sustainable wetland use
  • Community awareness and participation in wetland protection

How to Apply

  1. No individual application is required under the programme
  2. Communities participate through the wetland management committees

Required Documents

  • Not applicable for general beneficiaries
meta_title: National Wetland Conservation Programme: Protecting Wetlands
meta_description: The National Wetland Conservation Programme conserves India's wetlands for biodiversity, water security, and livelihoods. Learn more.

content:
Overview

The National Afforestation Programme is a centrally sponsored scheme for the regeneration of degraded forests and tree planting across India. Implemented through state forest departments and joint forest management committees, the programme supports plantation, soil and water conservation, and the improvement of forest ecosystems. It also provides employment to local communities through forest works.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The programme operates in degraded forest areas identified by state forest departments
  • Local communities and joint forest management committees participate in plantation
  • No individual application is required

Benefits

  • Regeneration of degraded forests and increased green cover
  • Soil and water conservation in forest areas
  • Employment for local communities in plantation and maintenance
  • Improved biodiversity and ecosystem services

How to Apply

  1. No individual application is required under the programme
  2. Community participation happens through joint forest management committees

Required Documents

  • Not applicable for general beneficiaries
meta_title: National Afforestation Programme: Restoring India's Forests
meta_description: The National Afforestation Programme regenerates degraded forests with community participation and employment. Learn about the programme.

content:
Overview

The Green Skill Development Programme (GSDP) is an initiative of the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change to build skills in environment and forestry related sectors. The programme provides training in areas such as waste management, solar energy, organic farming, and biodiversity conservation. Trained candidates receive certificates and are equipped for green jobs and entrepreneurship.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Youth and professionals interested in environment related careers
  • Minimum qualification varies by the training programme
  • Priority for candidates from rural and disadvantaged backgrounds

Benefits

  • Free or subsidised skill training in green sectors
  • Certification recognised in the environment and forestry sectors
  • Employment and entrepreneurship opportunities in green jobs
  • Support for the growth of a skilled green workforce

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the GSDP training centres and partner institutions
  2. Complete the training and assessment for the selected course
  3. Receive the certificate and placement support

Required Documents

  • Educational qualification certificates
  • Identity proof
meta_title: Green Skill Development Programme: Training for Green Jobs
meta_description: GSDP trains youth in waste management, solar energy, organic farming, and biodiversity for green jobs. Check eligibility and how to apply.

content:
Overview

Prakriti Kheti Khushhal Kisan is a central scheme launched to promote natural farming practices in India. The scheme supports farmers in adopting chemical free, nature based farming methods through cluster demonstrations, training, and certification support. It aligns with the national goal of promoting sustainable agriculture and reducing input costs for farmers.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Farmers willing to adopt natural farming practices
  • Farmer clusters are formed for demonstration and training
  • Priority for small and marginal farmers

Benefits

  • Training and handholding for natural farming methods
  • Support for bio-input preparation and use
  • Certification and marketing support for natural produce
  • Reduced input costs and better soil health

How to Apply

  1. Contact the district agriculture office for natural farming clusters
  2. Enrol in the training and demonstration programme
  3. Receive support for bio-inputs and certification

Required Documents

  • Land records
  • Aadhaar card and bank account details
meta_title: Prakriti Kheti Khushhal Kisan: Natural Farming Support
meta_description: Prakriti Kheti Khushhal Kisan promotes chemical free natural farming with training and certification support for farmers. Check eligibility.

content:
Overview

Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY) is a guaranteed pension scheme for senior citizens aged 60 years and above, administered by the Life Insurance Corporation of India. The scheme provides a fixed pension for 10 years with an attractive return, payable monthly, quarterly, half yearly, or annually. On maturity, the entire purchase amount is returned to the policyholder.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Indian citizens aged 60 years and above
  • Purchase amount within the limits prescribed under the scheme
  • No medical examination is required

Benefits

  • Guaranteed pension for 10 years at the scheme's interest rate
  • Flexible pension frequency options
  • Return of the purchase amount on maturity
  • Option to cover spouse jointly under the policy

How to Apply

  1. Visit an LIC branch or apply online on the LIC portal
  2. Fill the proposal form and choose the pension option
  3. Pay the purchase amount and receive the policy
  4. Pension is credited as per the chosen frequency

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card and PAN card
  • Age proof
  • Bank account details
meta_title: PM Vaya Vandana Yojana: 10-Year Guaranteed Pension Plan
meta_description: PMVVY provides a guaranteed 10-year pension to senior citizens aged 60+ with the purchase amount returned at maturity. Check eligibility.

content:
Overview

Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY) provides free assisted living devices to senior citizens from below poverty line families. Implemented by ALIMCO under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, the scheme distributes walking sticks, crutches, hearing aids, wheelchairs, and spectacles to eligible elderly persons. Devices are provided through camps at the district and block level.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Senior citizens aged 60 years and above
  • Belonging to below poverty line families as per the SECC database
  • Beneficiaries with low vision, hearing loss, or mobility impairment

Benefits

  • Free assisted living devices customised to the beneficiary's needs
  • Improved mobility and independence for the elderly
  • Distribution through accessible camp locations
  • No cost to the beneficiary for the devices

How to Apply

  1. Eligible persons are identified from the SECC database
  2. Attend the Vayoshri camp when organised in your district
  3. Complete the assessment and receive the device

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card
  • BPL identification
  • Age proof
meta_title: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana: Free Devices for Elderly BPL
meta_description: RVY gives free walking sticks, hearing aids, wheelchairs, and spectacles to BPL senior citizens aged 60+. Check eligibility and camps.

content:
Overview

Elder Line 14567 is a 24-hour toll free helpline for senior citizens in India, operated by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. The helpline provides information, guidance, and emergency support for elderly persons facing abuse, neglect, loneliness, or any distress. Calls are answered by trained counsellors who connect seniors to the appropriate services.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to all senior citizens in India
  • Family members and concerned citizens can also call on behalf of the elderly
  • The service is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week

Benefits

  • Immediate assistance for elderly persons in distress
  • Counselling and emotional support over the phone
  • Referral to medical, legal, and social services
  • Support for elderly persons facing abuse or neglect

How to Apply

  1. Dial 14567 from any phone, free of cost
  2. Explain the situation to the helpline counsellor
  3. Receive the required support and follow-up assistance

Required Documents

  • No documents are required to call the helpline
meta_title: Elder Line 14567: 24-Hour Helpline for Senior Citizens
meta_description: Elder Line 14567 is a free 24-hour helpline providing support, counselling, and emergency assistance to senior citizens in India.

content:
Overview

The National Policy on Older Persons, adopted in 1999, is a framework of the Government of India for the welfare of senior citizens. The policy covers income security, healthcare, shelter, and protection of the elderly, and encourages the participation of older persons in society. It guides the formulation of schemes and programmes for senior citizens at the central and state levels.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The policy applies to all senior citizens aged 60 years and above
  • Benefits are implemented through schemes and programmes under the policy
  • Specific eligibility depends on the individual scheme

Benefits

  • Framework for income security and pension schemes for the elderly
  • Guidance for healthcare and geriatric services
  • Support for shelters and institutional care for the needy
  • Protection of the rights of older persons

How to Apply

  1. Senior citizens avail benefits through the specific schemes under the policy
  2. Contact the district social welfare office for scheme guidance

Required Documents

  • As required by the specific scheme
meta_title: National Policy on Older Persons: Senior Citizen Welfare
meta_description: The National Policy on Older Persons guides income security, healthcare, and protection programmes for senior citizens in India. Learn more.

content:
Overview

Vayoshreshtha Samman is a national award conferred by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment to eminent senior citizens and institutions serving the elderly. The awards recognise outstanding contributions in fields such as social service, healthcare, education, and community development. The awards are presented on International Day of Older Persons, honouring the achievements of older Indians.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Senior citizens aged 60 years and above with distinguished contributions
  • Institutions and organisations serving the welfare of the elderly
  • Nominations are invited from the public and government agencies

Benefits

  • National recognition for the contributions of senior citizens
  • Inspiration for community service and elderly welfare
  • Public honour at the national awards ceremony

How to Apply

  1. Nominations are submitted through the official portal or by post
  2. Provide details of the nominee's contributions and achievements
  3. Shortlisted nominees are evaluated by the award committee

Required Documents

  • Nomination form with details of contributions
  • Supporting documents and references
meta_title: Vayoshreshtha Samman: National Awards for Senior Citizens
meta_description: Vayoshreshtha Samman is a national award honouring eminent senior citizens and institutions serving the elderly. Learn how to nominate.

content:
Overview

The National Council for Older Persons (NCOP) is an advisory body of the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment that advises the government on policies and programmes for senior citizens. The council includes experts, representatives of states, and senior citizen organisations. It reviews the implementation of the National Policy on Older Persons and suggests measures for the welfare of the elderly.

Eligibility Criteria

  • The council comprises nominated experts, officials, and representatives of senior citizen organisations
  • Senior citizen organisations can recommend members for the council
  • No individual membership application process is generally open

Benefits

  • Advisory inputs for elderly welfare policies
  • Review of schemes for senior citizens
  • Representation of the concerns of older persons at the national level

How to Apply

  1. Senior citizen organisations can approach the ministry for representation
  2. Membership follows the government's nomination process

Required Documents

  • As per the nomination process of the ministry
meta_title: National Council for Older Persons: Elderly Welfare Advisory
meta_description: NCOP advises the government on policies and programmes for senior citizens in India. Learn about its role and composition.

content:
Overview

The National Institute of Social Defence, along with regional institutes, works on the welfare of the elderly through research, training, and capacity building. Under the senior citizen component, the institute trains geriatric care providers, conducts research on ageing, and develops models for elder care. It supports the implementation of programmes for the well-being of older persons.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Training programmes are open to professionals and caregivers in elder care
  • Researchers and students can engage with the institute's programmes
  • No individual benefits are distributed directly

Benefits

  • Training for caregivers and geriatric service providers
  • Research on ageing and elder care models
  • Capacity building for organisations serving the elderly

How to Apply

  1. Apply for training programmes through the institute's portal
  2. Participate in workshops and research activities

Required Documents

  • As required by the specific training or programme
meta_title: National Institute for the Elderly: Geriatric Training & Research
meta_description: The National Institute of Social Defence trains geriatric caregivers and researches elder care models for senior citizen welfare. Learn more.

content:
Overview

Day Care Centres for Senior Citizens are facilities that provide daytime care, companionship, and activities for elderly persons whose families are unable to look after them during working hours. The centres offer recreational activities, health monitoring, meals, and social interaction under trained staff. They are run by NGOs and agencies with support from the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Senior citizens who need daytime care and supervision
  • Elderly persons living alone or with working families
  • Services are typically provided free or at nominal charges

Benefits

  • Safe daytime care and supervision for the elderly
  • Social interaction reducing loneliness and isolation
  • Health monitoring and assistance with daily activities
  • Relief for family members who work during the day

How to Apply

  1. Locate a day care centre near your area through the district social welfare office
  2. Register the senior citizen with basic details
  3. Visit the centre and avail the services as per the schedule

Required Documents

  • Age proof
  • Address proof and emergency contact details
meta_title: Day Care Centres for Senior Citizens: Care & Companionship
meta_description: Day care centres for senior citizens provide daytime care, health monitoring, meals, and social activities. Learn how to access services.

content:
Overview

The Continuing Education Programme for Seniors is an initiative that provides learning opportunities for senior citizens to stay engaged and active. The programme offers classes and workshops on topics such as computers, languages, arts, health, and digital literacy at designated centres. It supports lifelong learning and the mental well-being of older persons.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to senior citizens, generally aged 60 years and above
  • No educational qualification is required
  • Courses are offered at nominal or no cost at government supported centres

Benefits

  • Opportunity for lifelong learning and skill development
  • Improved digital literacy and connectivity with family
  • Social engagement and mental stimulation
  • Access to new hobbies and creative activities

How to Apply

  1. Visit the nearest continuing education centre or senior citizen association
  2. Enrol for the desired course with basic details
  3. Attend the classes as per the schedule

Required Documents

  • Age proof
  • Identity card
meta_title: Continuing Education Programme for Seniors: Lifelong Learning
meta_description: The Continuing Education Programme offers courses in computers, digital literacy, arts, and health for senior citizens. Learn how to enrol.

content:
Overview

The Senior Citizens Health Insurance Scheme provides health insurance cover for elderly persons aged 60 years and above in India. Under the programme, senior citizens receive coverage for hospitalisation, day care procedures, and other medical expenses at affordable premiums. The scheme addresses the higher healthcare needs of the elderly and reduces out of pocket medical spending.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Senior citizens aged 60 years and above
  • Coverage is available through the public health insurance scheme or designated insurers
  • Premium may be subsidised for eligible categories as per the programme

Benefits

  • Hospitalisation cover for illnesses and procedures
  • Cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals
  • Coverage for pre-existing conditions subject to policy terms
  • Reduced financial burden of healthcare for the elderly

How to Apply

  1. Apply through the designated health insurance agency or the state health scheme
  2. Complete the enrolment with identity and health details
  3. Receive the health card and avail cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals

Required Documents

  • Aadhaar card
  • Age proof
  • Bank account details
meta_title: Senior Citizens Health Insurance: Cover for Age 60+
meta_description: Senior citizens health insurance covers hospitalisation and medical expenses for persons aged 60+. Check eligibility and how to enrol.
